From the #154 Clean Code second pass (SQF error handling).

- `addons/main/functions/fn_effectApply.sqf:112` — `_args getOrDefault ["size", 8]`: a `squad_spawned` effect missing `size` silently spawns an invented 8-man Squad. The daemon owns composition strength (ccd7af3 made it data); the sibling arms refuse malformed effects with a typed verdict — this one should refuse too, not guess.
- `spike/probes/reinforce.sqf:65`, `spike/probes/client-port.sqf:60,423` — hand-minted `round (diag_tickTime * 1000)` request ids, the collision idiom `cti_fnc_requestId` (#103) was built to retire; the daemon dedupes on the whole line, so a same-millisecond `view` is answered from the record instead of fresh.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] A `squad_spawned` effect without `size` draws a refused/typed verdict, not an 8-man default; the no-Arma tier covers the daemon side if applicable.
- [ ] The three hand-minted ids ride `cti_fnc_requestId`.
- [ ] `just fast` + `just build` green; touched in-world surfaces gated per the regress rule when landed.

Cross-reference: #154 (findings 20, 27), #103, #91 (same file, tracked separately).
